def block_quote(self, token: Dict[str, Any], state: BlockState) -> str:
    text = indent(self.render_children(token, state), '   ')
    prev = token['prev']
    ignore_blocks = (
        'paragraph',
        'thematic_break',
        'linebreak',
        'heading',
    )
    if prev and prev['type'] not in ignore_blocks:
        text = '..\n\n' + text
